analyst: The script uses a Pivot confirmation entry around the volume-profile POC. A long opens when price moves outside the POC channel to the upside, the POC delta imbalance is positive, close is above the VWMA, confirmation volume is high, the Smart Trail agrees, and the session and skip-window filters allow it. A short opens when price moves outside the POC channel to the downside, the POC delta imbalance is negative, close is below the VWMA, confirmation volume is high, the Smart Trail agrees, and the session and skip-window filters allow it. Its stop is the Stop ($) input, default 250, converted by the point value, and it can trail if the trailing-stop setting is enabled.
